The Haier Google TV features an HQLED DLED panel producing a native 4K UHD resolution of 3840 x 2160 pixels across the full 43-inch screen. AIPQ Intelligent Picture Quality Engine

The Haier Smart TV runs the AIPQ intelligent picture processing engine for continuous, scene-by-scene picture optimization. AI algorithms analyze incoming content and automatically adjust sharpness, color, contrast, and noise reduction parameters in real time. This Haier 43P7 PRO 43 Inch 4K TV has seven picture modes including Standard, Vivid, Sports, Movie, Game, and Energy Saving give users manual control when preferred. Full HDR decoding support alongside Dolby Vision ensures compatibility with the widest possible range of HDR content sources. Streaming platforms including Netflix and Amazon Prime Video deliver Dolby Vision content directly to this Haier 43 Inch HQLED Smart TV without any additional hardware.

30W Dolby Atmos Dual Speaker Audio System

The Haier 43 Inch 4K Smart TV delivers 30W of total audio output through two 15W stereo speakers with full Dolby Digital decoding and Dolby Atmos support. Dolby Atmos creates a spatial, multidimensional soundstage that places audio elements around and above the listener for immersive entertainment. Thsi Haier 43P7 PRO 43 Inch 4K Smart TV has sound Surround, Auto Volume Levelling, and Sound Balance controls give users precise command over their audio experience at all times. Google TV OS on Android 14 with Unified Content Discovery

Netflix, YouTube, Amazon Prime Video, Google Play Store, and a built-in web browser all come pre-installed and ready to use immediately. Google Assistant responds to voice commands for content search, smart home control, and information queries directly through the Bluetooth remote.

Google Assistant and Chromecast Built-In

The Haier Smart TV integrates Google Assistant natively for hands-free voice control across all TV functions and connected smart home devices. With Haier 43P7 PRO 43 Inch 4K TV, users search for content, switch inputs, adjust volume, and ask general knowledge questions entirely through natural spoken commands.
